scope: First loop-level theory domain with a running mass: Gamma(H -> b bbar) with the MS-bar mass mbar_b(mu) and alpha_s(mu), massless b at leading power, QCD corrections through alpha_s^4 (s_1..s_3 exact from hep-ph/9608318 eq. 21, s_4 at n_f = 5 from hep-ph/0511063 Table I), the scale dependence of coupling and mass derived from the RGE and checked mu-independent order by order in exact arithmetic, and the scale envelope, truncation estimate and parametric alpha_s and m_b variations as separate objects. Validity: n_f = 5, mu in [M_H/2, 2 M_H].
exclusions: Power corrections m_b^2 / M_H^2, top-induced (singlet) and electroweak corrections
Flavour-threshold matching (n_f = 5 is kept up to 2 M_H, above the top mass)
Any experiment, detector, data or blinding field; no comparison with a measured width or branching ratio
Claims of formal proof or of coverage of the scale envelope

capabilities.name: running-mass-scale-dependence
capabilities.scope: SymPy derivation of r_n(L) from s_1..s_4, gamma_0..gamma_3 and beta_0..beta_3; r_n(0) = s_n; m(mu)^2 times the truncated series mu-independent through its order (N = 1..4), negative test with a wrong gamma_0; coefficient and normalization cross-checks against a second source (perturbative argument, not formal proof)

capabilities.name: running-mass-width-prediction
capabilities.scope: Gamma(H -> b bbar) at orders alpha_s^0..alpha_s^4 with the scale envelope, truncation estimate and parametric alpha_s and m_b variations reported separately
